title: Algerian Quinoa Tagine
description: A hearty, flavorful dish from North Africa, made with quinoa and aromatic spices. Perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: 2. Rinse the quinoa in a fine-mesh strainer and drain well.
3. In a large bowl, whisk together the Algerian Aromatic Spice Blend and 2 cups of water.
4. Add the quinoa to the bowl and stir to coat.
5. Bring the quinoa mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the quinoa is tender and the water has been absorbed.
6. While the quinoa cooks, season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
7. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through.
8. Serve the chicken on top of the cooked quinoa, garnished with fresh herbs and a side of tagine for serving.
